title: Grouping, Aggregation & Subqueries
description: GROUP BY, HAVING, rollup/cube/grouping sets, PIVOT, CTEs (including recursive), subqueries, and comparison operators (ANY, ALL, EXISTS).
longDescription: This module covers advanced querying techniques in SQL Server. You'll learn how to group and aggregate data, use CTEs for readable queries, work with subqueries, and apply set comparison operators.
whatYouLearn: Group data using GROUP BY and aggregate functions
Use CUBE, ROLLUP, and GROUPING SETS for advanced grouping
Convert rows to columns using PIVOT
Write readable queries using Common Table Expressions (CTE)
Query hierarchical data using recursive CTE
Use correlated subqueries for row-by-row comparisons
Apply EXISTS, ANY, and ALL operators for set comparisons
